# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
platform macos
# A title supplements the destination instead of hiding it.
tap id:case-link-hover
event id:destination onMouseEnter
wait 600
expect Documentation reference
expect https://example.com
expect /docs
event id:destination onMouseLeave
wait 20
absent Documentation reference
# window-open
tap id:case-window-open
expect Windows: main
expect Get: true none none
tap id:open
expect Result: same true, main false, parent true, state null
expect Windows: main,first,second
expect Get: true first second
expect In first: main false, parent none, shared 0
expect In second: main false, parent main, shared 0
# One engine renders every window: the app's signals reach them.
tap id:shared
expect In first: main false, parent none, shared 1
tap id:close
expect Result: closed, state null, get null
expect Windows: main
expect Closes: 1
absent In first: main false, parent none, shared 1
covers [nsh/desktop] Window
covers [nsh/desktop] windows
covers [nsh/desktop] currentWindow
# window-element
tap id:case-window-element
expect Windows: main
expect Open: false changes none events none
absent Never shown
tap id:toggle
expect Windows: main,inspector
expect Inside inspector
tap id:rename
expect Inside inspector
# The app closed it: no onOpenChange.
tap id:toggle
expect Windows: main
expect Open: false changes none events none
tap id:toggle
expect Inside inspector
tap id:close
expect Windows: main
expect Open: false changes false close events none
absent Inside inspector
covers [nsh/desktop] Window

# window-props
tap id:case-window-props
expect Document
prop id:bar desktop.windowDrag true
prop id:minimize desktop.windowControl minimize
prop id:maximize desktop.windowControl maximize
prop id:close desktop.windowControl close
prop id:edge desktop.windowResize right
prop id:corner desktop.windowResize bottomRight
covers [props] desktop.windowControl
covers [props] desktop.windowResize
# tray-click
tap id:case-tray-click
expect Tray clicks: none
# A click where the system says where the icon is (macOS, Windows): its
# frame on the screen, in points.
tray click 1180 0 32 24
expect Tray clicks: 1180 0 32 24
# Where it does not (Linux): null.
tray click
expect Tray clicks: 1180 0 32 24, null
covers [nsh/desktop] Tray
# home-dir-access
tap id:case-home-dir-access
expect Home: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED homeDir ""
covers [os] homedir
# launch-at-login
tap id:case-launch-at-login
# A run that cannot launch at login (headless, as a view embedded in another
# app and `nsh run`): reading it is false, turning it on rejects, and so does
# a wrong use, with a TypeError.
expect Launch at login: boolean false
tap id:enable
expect Set: true ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM
tap id:misuse
expect Misuse: TypeError
covers [nsh/desktop] Application

# Hover tracks pass presses through while the content fits, and start
# receiving the pointer once it grows beyond the viewport on their axis.
tap id:case-scrollbar-hover
expect Grow
style label:"Vertical hover bar" pointerEvents none
style label:"Horizontal hover bar" pointerEvents none
tap id:resize-content
expect Shrink
style label:"Vertical hover bar" pointerEvents auto
style label:"Horizontal hover bar" pointerEvents auto
tap id:resize-content
expect Grow
style label:"Vertical hover bar" pointerEvents none
style label:"Horizontal hover bar" pointerEvents none
